Assignment: Document Data Extraction

**Product Overview**

Our customers store various types of documents in a folder , e.g., order forms, purchase orders. We need a solution that automatically processes this folder, identifies the document type, and extracts fields based on the customized definitions per customer and document type. The solution should extract both **Structured fields** and **Natural language–based data**.

**Goal**

Build pipeline that extracts fields according to the document type and customer definitions. **Success Criteria / KPIs**

1\. **Accuracy**: ≥95% correct extraction of fields

2\. **Coverage**: Works for at least 2 different document types.

3\. **Adaptability**: Handles at least 2 different customer-specific variations per document type.

**Field to be extract \- Order Form / Purchase Order :**

● Start date \- Format “mm-dd-yyy”

● End date \- Format “mm-dd-yyy”

● Amount

● Payment terms \- Format “Net xx”

● Billing address

● Customer signature \- True/False

● List of items

○ Product name

○ Quantity

○ Price

○ Total Amount

● Special terms | Burst \- on the item level

● Special terms | Technical account manager

**Technical Overview**  
Process any document landing in a dedicated folder and transform into tabular structured data ![][image1]
